description: Dry-runs data transformations against sample records and returns the transformed, dropped and quarantined results; nothing is stored. Give `transform` (an unsaved definition, get_data_transform format) or `transform_id`; with neither, all enabled transformations of the app run. Required scope: admin.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

transform.description: Unsaved transformation definition (kind + rules or code).

name: preview_data_transform
title: Preview data transformation
